listing.name: Arthr's Pirates but EPICer - MrMagolor Edition 1.3.1 "Fool Me Not At All"
listing.displayName: Arthr's Pirates but EPICer - MrMagolor Edition
listing.summary: Gives the pirates practically every ship/weapon/fighter/hullmod in your modlist.
listing.aiSummary: Equips pirate fleets with nearly all ships, weapons, fighters, and hullmods from the player's installed mods.

description: This mod drastically increases the variety and power of pirate fleets by assigning them equipment from other mods in your list. It warns that this will severely disrupt intended game progression. Enabling default role assignment for ships may significantly increase campaign load times depending on the size of your modlist.

changelog.1.3: adds Lunalib integration, allowing for much greater configurability of how crazy you want the game to be.
changelog.1.2:
Now has Version Checker support
 Hopefully modules no longer appear in fleets/markets
 Minor logging
 May or may not actually work
changelog.0.97:
Hopefully prevented a lot of crashes (if a crashing variant is still loaded, the fault is on the mod the variant is from for giving it a default role to begin with)
Fine-tuned the anti-module code some more (it isn't perfect but at this rate the things that get through might as well be normal ships)

Changed the version number from 0.96 to 0.97, wow!!!
